rules: POSE09 (A1 lead 17, 10 Nov): the owner's shield-and-sword lunge (owner_ref_10nov, function not a literal copy; mirrored to her kit: sword right, shield left) as a held still for L1's 09 look shot. Feet very wide and flat, toes out, both knees deep, the pelvis low, the weight a little to the shield leg; chest up and open (no rounded spine), head stacked, chest and face to the play camera; shield out in front to her left-front, boss near shoulder height, face clear, face out; sword low at the right hip the elbow drawn back, the blade pointing forward-right, level. Ease, not strain
